package: Six original-photo alpha-only cutouts, first pass
method: Non-generative background masking only. Native canvases and all decoded source RGB pixels preserved, including transparent pixels. No source rescaling or subject retouching. Original JPEG decoding defines pixel reference.
edge_quality: First-pass manual/deterministic masks, with antialiased alpha. Approximate fine hair and thin original-background fringes remain. No RGB edge decontamination.
missing_requested_pose: Hoodie original clips the head, so use the complete standing School photograph supplied here.
